description: This file defines a class SKAlert for creating and displaying alert dialogs with customizable buttons, titles, and messages. It includes functions for styling alert buttons based on their style variants.

classes.name: SKAlert
classes.description: A class for creating and managing alert dialog components with customizable buttons, title, and message.

methods.name: buttonsString
methods.description: Generates HTML string for the alert's buttons based on their styles and actions.

methods.name: templateString
methods.description: Creates the full HTML template string for the alert dialog, including title, message, and buttons.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Removes the alert component from the DOM.

methods.name: primaryButton
methods.description: Returns the primary button, or the last button if no primary is set.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the alert dialog on the specified DOM element or on the document body.
